name: Magnetism
scaffolding_intent: Two entities drift toward each other with sparkle particles, showing that they belong together or act together

parameters.name: entityPrefixB
parameters.description: Entity ID of the second element (attracted toward)

parameters.name: magnetScale
parameters.description: Size multiplier for the magnet sprites

parameters.name: sparkleCount
parameters.description: Number of sparkle particles at the contact point

parameters.name: sparkleRadius
parameters.description: Radius of the sparkle particle spread around the contact point

correction_intent: Child described as separate, apart, or unrelated two entities the scene shows together (sharing, holding hands, working side by side, one carrying the other). Target the two entities. Not for a wrong cause between them; that is R3.
suggestion_intent: The scene shows two entities clearly together (sharing an object, sitting side by side, one helping the other) and the child mentioned them separately or mentioned only one. Target the two entities so the child links them ('the girl and her mother').
